definitions.explanation: A chemical substance used for medical treatment or one that affects the body physiologically. In modern usage, frequently associated with illegal or controlled substances and drug abuse.

examples.japanese: {薬物|やくぶつ}の{乱用|らんよう}は{体|からだ}を{壊|こわ}す。
{薬物|やくぶつ}{検査|けんさ}で{陽性|ようせい}{反応|はんのう}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: The drug test came back positive.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}では{薬物|やくぶつ}の{危険性|きけんせい}について{啓発|けいはつ}{活動|かつどう}が{行|おこな}われている。
examples.english: Schools are conducting awareness activities about the dangers of drugs.

notes:
USAGE:
While technically neutral (meaning any pharmaceutical substance), in practice {薬物|やくぶつ} often carries a negative connotation and is strongly associated with illegal drugs and substance abuse. For everyday medicine, {薬|くすり} is more common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {薬|くすり}: medicine (everyday word)
- {薬物|やくぶつ}: drug/substance (often implies illegal or controlled substances)
- {薬剤|やくざい}: pharmaceutical, medication (technical/professional)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {薬物|やくぶつ}{乱用|らんよう}: drug abuse
- {薬物|やくぶつ}{依存|いぞん}: drug dependence/addiction
- {薬物|やくぶつ}{検査|けんさ}: drug test
- {薬物|やくぶつ}{犯罪|はんざい}: drug crime
